timeline.text: Artem's parents could only use the dose button if they'd already picked his food.
Any other time, the app just stopped — no numbers, no next step.
Now one button on Cloudflare Workers asks first: food, or no food at all?
Choose food and it adds carbs to the correction. Choose none and it doses on correction alone.
If blood sugar is stale, a Measure Now button appears right there — every path now ends in one tap.
